name: What are the benefits of regular deck maintenance beyond fascia repair?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of regular deck maintenance beyond fascia repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular deck maintenance, including cleaning, staining, and inspecting all components, extends the lifespan of your deck and enhances safety. Beyond fascia repair, properly maintained decks resist rot, insect infestation, and UV damage, preserving their structural integrity and appearance. Cleaning prevents mold and mildew buildup, while staining protects the wood. Proactive maintenance helps identify minor issues before they become costly repairs, saving you money in the long run. Consider developing a routine annual checklist to stay on top of maintenance tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular deck maintenance extends deck life, improves safety, prevents rot and insect damage, and saves money by addressing issues early. An annual checklist helps with this.
